description: Ministry of Industrial, Export and Investment Promotion - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2047/2 of 27.11.2017 (Reserved)
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979, amending the amount of CESS (a tax/levy) on specific articles (cement products). It involves the exercise of statutory powers to modify regulations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of ministers and ministries is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
